stories.title: Deputies: Female student brings knife to Westwood High School
South Carolina ranks 39th among best states to raise a family, ConsumerAffairs report says
stories.summary: South Carolina ranked seventh for affordability but 38th for safety and public education. Connecticut topped the 2026 list.

stories.title: South Carolina flu hospitalizations nearly triple the usual pace ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: State health data show 749 people hospitalized with flu since the season began Oct. 4. At this point last year, the number was 74.

stories.title: 18-year-old charged after shots fired at Boiling Springs Walmart
stories.summary: Mason Lee Finch faces breach of peace and obstruction of justice charges, deputies said. No one was hurt in the Sunday morning shooting.

stories.title: McMaster lights South Carolina's Christmas tree for the last time as governor
stories.summary: WLTX's J.R. Berry hosted the 60th Governor's Carolighting, featuring Patrick Davis singing 'Carolina When I Die' and McMaster leading 'Jesus Loves Me.'

stories.title: Three teams vie to rebuild I-26/I-126 interchange in next phase of Malfunction Junction fix
stories.summary: All three teams that applied made the shortlist. The state expects the $340 million to $440 million phase to be substantially complete by April 2032.

stories.title: Orangeburg County coroner identifies man, 69, who died after being hit on Highway 178
stories.summary: Robert Caffey, of Orangeburg, died of injuries from being hit by an SUV early Friday on North Road at Hampton Drive, the coroner said.

stories.title: Richland County Council gives first approval to rezoning for up to 147 homes on Koon Road
stories.summary: Some neighbors warned about flooding before the unanimous vote. The rezoning still needs two more readings before it becomes final.

stories.title: Recovery fund set up for Lexington County deputy shot at Jamil Temple gun show
stories.summary: Deputy Eugene Hammill has had multiple surgeries since the Nov. 14 shooting. Organizers say all money raised will go directly to him.

stories.title: SC State plans new animal and veterinary sciences degree starting in fall 2027
stories.summary: Students who love animals may soon have a new path to vet school that starts in Orangeburg. Here's what SC State is planning, and what's still pending.

stories.title: Neighbors on one Elloree street are still shaken by what they saw Friday morning
stories.summary: A neighbor says she heard someone yelling for help but couldn't get close because of the heat. The coroner says three people were found dead inside.

stories.title: The state has pinpointed where that Lower Richland smell is coming from. Questions remain
stories.summary: “It stinks worse up here,” one neighbor says. Columbia Water hasn’t said how long sewage overflowed or whether nearby water could be affected.
